details: The package ships a credential- and wallet-harvesting toolkit under.yalc/detector together with a harvested report from a victim machine. The tool scans desktop wallet directories and browser-extension LevelDB vaults for MetaMask, Phantom, Trust Wallet, Coinbase, Binance, OKX, Rabby, Keplr, TronLink, Ronin, Solflare and Exodus, and extracts secrets from.env and.npmrc files (npm tokens and _authToken values). The bundled report (report-2026-08-28T19-03-15[.]zip) contains a captured MetaMask vault (LevelDB files under the extension id nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn) and real GitLab personal access tokens (glpat-...) and npm auth tokens from a captured.npmrc.
